REJECT.notePlaceholder: E.g. past the 7-day exchange window, offered a free alteration

RECEIVE.title: Garment received
RECEIVE.description: The garment for ticket {code} is at the shop.
RECEIVE.notePlaceholder: E.g. tags still on, sleeve re-measured at 56 cm

READY.title: Work done
READY.description: Ticket {code} moves to ready to return.
READY.feeHint: Leave empty if free (within window or the shop's fault).
READY.notePlaceholder: E.g. waist taken in 2 cm, pickup tomorrow afternoon

REQUEST_REFUND.title: Send refund for approval
REQUEST_REFUND.description: Refunding return ticket {code} needs Super Admin approval.
REQUEST_REFUND.approvalNote: The transfer happens after approval; the ticket waits under “Ready to return”.
REQUEST_REFUND.notePlaceholder: E.g. tags still on, wrong item shipped by the shop

DONE.title: Close ticket
DONE.description: The customer got the garment back or was refunded for ticket {code}.
DONE.notePlaceholder: E.g. customer tried it on, fits well

toast.REQUEST_REFUND: Refund for ticket {code} sent for approval.
